highest_value_findings: The therapy lineage self-corrected from strong claims to an explicit recognition that same-model dialogue plus a shared keyword evaluator creates a self-reinforcing measurement loop. Preserve the whole sequence as a Goodhart/falsification oracle.
Same-model prompt personas are not independent experimental agents or controls; they inherit the same weights/training/RLHF blind spots.
A classifier that both drives persistent state changes and evaluates their success contaminates the outcome signal; actuator and evaluator need causal separation or independent validation.
Persistence DB writes did not imply live delivery, and replay initially erased system-message role. State persistence, event delivery, replay class and allowed actions need separate receipts.
Scheduled autonomous agents directly targeting persistent personality dimensions require explicit governance, bounded reversible update authority and counterfactual controls.
Pairwise PID overlap gates across five agents expose the need for a central resource lease/scheduler rather than O(n^2) local exclusions.
Prompt-only local/cloud prohibitions are insufficient as hard policy; external connectivity belongs in typed capability/effect authority.
README injection makes documentation executable self-model configuration and therefore requires hash/version pinning plus runtime conformance.

branch_feedback.gwt_harness: Use preregistered baselines, independent evaluators, sham interventions, withheld-intervention periods, lesions/rescue and long-run held-out trajectories. Same-model role prompts do not count as independent controls.
branch_feedback.harness: Add state-write-vs-live-event, replay-role preservation, self-reinforcing-evaluator, same-model-echo-chamber, autonomous-state-mutation-governance and stale-document-self-model fixtures.
branch_feedback.unifieddb_rae: Represent raw private transcript, public summary, primary chat event and persistent personality mutation as separate provenance classes with causal links and epochs.
branch_feedback.research_center: Replace pairwise worker/entity PID exclusions with typed central leases/resource arbitration and explicit collision/priority semantics.
branch_feedback.needle_claycode: Capability locality, effect authority, persistent-state update budget and model-generated proposal/intervention must be typed runtime contracts, not prompt-only directives.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Track evaluator->state-update->future-prompt feedback edges so self-reinforcing measurement loops can be detected as causal cycles rather than mistaken for independent evidence.
